programs.title: First Dates
programs.desc: Fred gives some of the daters a flirting masterclass, a fashion lover seeks a geek with a heart, and a smooth-talking handyman gets his ukulele out.

programs.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programs.title: Boiling Point

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Paratrooper Lee has catastrophic spine, pelvis and leg injuries that require high-risk surgery using bone hooks. And a plasterer is put in a coma after a head-on traffic collision.

programs.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programs.desc: Young Henry has been hit by a forklift truck driven by his dad. Best mates Dean and Nahum are reeling from a car crash. And 94-year-old Pearl shares a tale of wartime romance.

programs.title: Car S.O.S
programs.desc: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend head to Wolverhampton to restore a 1980 Jaguar XJ-S V12, a great British grand tourer that has fallen into neglect.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: At a sprawling ranch in Texas, Mike flips for a VW bus that's been turned into a hunting lodge on wheels. And an heirloom re-ignites Frank's high-school obsession.

programs.title: Narrow Escapes
programs.desc: Stained-glass artist Kate welcomes us aboard her floating workshop. In Lincoln, Rob and Ade set off on a summer adventure. Solo boater Stuart heads home from Hemel Hempstead.
